{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Cream silk blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed fit, hip length, ivory (#FFFFF0), fine crepe.
Charcoal wool trousers with a wide leg, tailored cut, ankle length, deep grey (#36454F), heavy worsted wool.
Structured tweed blazer with notch lapels, single-breasted, hip length, dark brown (#4E342E), woven boucle.
Nude leather pumps with a 7cm block heel, pointed toe, calf length, soft suede.
Gold-plated hoop earrings, medium size, round shape, polished metal, gold (#FFD700).
Delicate pearl choker necklace, thin strand, oval shape, fresh water pearls, white (#FFFFFF).
Small structured leather clutch, rigid boxy shape, wrist strap, tan (#D2B48C), grained calfskin.

This outfit strikes a perfect balance between the evening setting of the theatre and her requested "neat" dress code by choosing refined fabrics and a structured silhouette that feels elegant yet wearable for autumn. The warm cream blouse contrasts beautifully with the dark charcoal trousers, creating a sophisticated monochromatic base that is anchored by the earthy tone of the tweed blazer. Accessories are kept minimal and classic—the gold hoops and pearl choker add a touch of subtle glamour suitable for a performance, while the nude pumps elongate the leg without overwhelming the understated look. Finally, the clutch provides a practical yet stylish finishing touch that complements the entire ensemble without violating any of her preferences or the time of day."}
